tracks.name: Core Rust Language
tracks.description: Follow Modules 1–19 for the main progression: language fundamentals, ownership, abstractions, I/O, concurrency, async, testing, and macros.

tracks.name: Unsafe Systems and FFI
tracks.description: Learn safe abstractions and type-system invariants before low-level raw pointers, unsafe contracts, and foreign interfaces.

tracks.name: Backend and Networking
tracks.description: Prioritize error handling, Cargo, I/O, async, networking, data storage, production security, and release workflow.

tracks.name: Embedded Rust
tracks.description: Focus on ownership, small abstractions, no_std, target configuration, hardware interfaces, and resource limits.

tracks.name: WebAssembly and Cross-Platform
tracks.description: Focus on portable libraries, explicit host bindings, data conversion, target builds, and cross-platform tests.

tracks.name: Performance and Reliability
tracks.description: Measure before optimizing; examine allocations, binary footprint, synchronization, diagnostics, and repeatable releases.
